search.snippet: Marigold seeds can be planted in a flower patch at level 2 Farming to yield marigolds, which are used to make imp repellent or as payment to protect hammerstone hops. When fully grown, it protects potato, onion, and tomato plants from disease.
search.title: Marigold seed - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: Understanding what a marigold actually does in OSRS changes the way you plan your farm runs. Instead of gambling on your potato, onion, and tomato patches surviving, you can plant a cheap flower seed next to them and let the game handle the rest.
search.title: OSRS Marigold Guide: Grow, Protect & Profit

search.snippet: A marigold seed is used in the Farming skill to grow Marigolds. They may be obtained by pickpocketing Master Farmers stealing them from Olivia s seed stall in Draynor Village or purchasing them from either Olivias Draynor Seed Market or Coeden s seed store.
search.title: How To Farm Marigold Osrs - Farm Info Mania

search.snippet: Sowing marigold seeds is quite easy and they can also be started in seed trays or pots. Sow in spring when temps are 10-25 deg Celsius.
search.title: When Do I Plant My Marigold Seeds in Ground in... | TikTok

search.snippet: What Does a Marigold Seed Head Look Like? A marigold seed head that’s ready to harvest isn’t particularly pretty. The bright petals will have dried and shrivelled, and the base of the flower will be brown and dry. This is what one of mine looked like when I collected it
